subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers split and retire this broad field-report issue now, or keep it open until every historical slice is fixed, rejected, or linked to a focused tracker?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 prove partial fixes and multiple focused open trackers, but not a single complete implementation or canonical replacement for all reported slices; closing or preserving the umbrella is an issue-hygiene and product-routing choice.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Link unresolved slices to focused trackers such as invalid-config fallback and missed-inbound catch-up, preserve this issue as evidence, and close it once the mapping is explicit.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Continue using this issue as the broad production field-report tracker while maintainers audit unsplit slices such as isolated cron web search and resource/default policy.

options.title: Close as partially superseded
options.body: Close now with links to the strongest active canonical issues, accepting that weaker slices need fresh focused reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Link unresolved slices to focused trackers such as invalid-config fallback and missed-inbound catch-up, preserve this issue as evidence, and close it once the mapping is explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a cross-surface product-routing and issue-hygiene decision, and this handle appears in live related-item reviews and closure comments for several affected slices.
